diagnosis.reference: Sustained UDP cross traffic of 15 Mbit/s from guest1 floods the 10 Mbit/s link through wan1 (eth2), and nothing on that edge protects the assured class 10 for user1 to external1.

arguments.name: eth2
arguments.reason: The egress interface eth2 toward external1 currently has an HTB root with default 0x20 but no classes, filters, or parent rate (tc qdisc show dev eth2). Under guest1's saturating flow the user1->external1 flow cannot get its 8 Mbps guarantee. Rebuild the hierarchy: 20Mbit root, protected class 13Mbit (8M guarantee + ~10% header margin), best-effort class 7Mbit, default to best-effort, and classify user1's traffic by destination 203.0.113.0/24 into the protected class.
